summary: Viewed the supplied portrait and all 18 poses at native 1x and nearest 3x, including light, dark and checker backgrounds. The right-facing three-quarter head, bare topknot, white beard, broad muted-green sleeves, red lining and bronze bell staff form a coherent silhouette. Robe highlights and underside shadows give readable volume with broadly consistent upper-left lighting. No obvious unintended interior holes or broken limb outlines are visible; boot silhouettes have weak contrast on the dark background but remain identifiable. Standing feet stay on a consistent ground line, and the fallen body reads as lying down. Idle changes are restrained; gathering, spreading the stance, extending the staff and recovering are distinguishable. The horizontal attack staff looks foreshortened compared with its upright length, but its grip remains readable. Skill preparation visibly gathers a cyan light at the chest; three cyan branches originate at the actual staff bell in skill_b; skill_c returns upright with separated residual fragments. Poison alternates an abdominal clutch and a hand raised toward the mouth, stun adds a swaying posture and overhead stars, and sleep uses closed eyes with a small settling change. These read as distinct states rather than palette tints or unrelated attacks. Sleep motion is subtle at 1x. This is a static pose-preview recommendation, not a user selection or approval: animation timing, in-battle readability, source authorship and model provenance cannot be established from these PNGs.
